description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs: The DFS cycle guard computes spki_der_bytes for each in-path cert on every candidate comparison, giving O(depth^2) allocations per DFS frame. Not a correctness issue. Fix when profiling shows it matters: cache encoded SPKI bytes alongside the path Vec, or use SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned::PartialEq directly (no allocation).
title: spki_der_bytes re-encodes in-path certs on every candidate comparison
